user.title: MIDI Player
user.description: Select the ESPHome device that includes the MIDI Player package and enter how many buzzers it has.

error.invalid_device: The selected device is not an ESPHome device.
error.actions_missing: The device does not provide the MIDI Player actions. Add the MIDI Player package to the ESPHome configuration, install it and make sure the device is online.

abort.already_configured: This ESPHome device is already configured.
abort.no_esphome_devices: No ESPHome devices were found. Add your ESP32 with the ESPHome integration first.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The number of buzzers was updated.

play_file.name: Play file
play_file.description: Selects a MIDI file from the library and plays it from the beginning.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: The name of a file in the MIDI library, for example song.mid.

buzzer.name: Buzzer
buzzer.description: The buzzer number to use. The current selection is kept when this is left empty.

delete_file.name: Delete file
delete_file.description: Deletes a MIDI file from the library.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: The name of the file to delete.

rescan_library.name: Rescan library
rescan_library.description: Reads the MIDI library folder again. Use this after copying files into the folder manually.
